purpose: Test animation-related rendering contribution before any production change or host-wide trace.
design: Same frozen production source, optimized APK pair, four-core affinity, admission threshold and thirty-query workload.
A1 uses exact original absent/default-one animation setting; B uses zero; A2 restores the original presence/value.
Fresh target process per run, same APK hashes and source fingerprint required.
Require complete timing/phase pairing and preserve per-family ready/draw/CPU medians.
Stop on any missing result, mismatch or failure; verify exact setting restoration and original emulator boot.

findings_closed: Interrupt/communication failure could release settings while child remained active.
Unequal metric arrays could truncate comparison data.

interpretation_limits: B is deliberately not qualification evidence and cannot close the unchanged animation-enabled release gate.
Any contribution is animation-related, not Aurora-only attribution.
Inconsistent A conditions leave host drift unresolved.
No production or issuer-account data changes are made.

completed_live_control.interpretation: The disabled condition has no clear overall p95 advantage over the two enabled conditions. This comparison does not support an animation-based production fix.
completed_live_control.limit: One local diagnostic comparison, with per-family variation and host drift; this does not prove animations have zero cost or explain the hosted failure.

host_topology_correction.explanation: Mask 15 selects logical processors 0/1 and 2/3 on two physical cores. Existing four-core diagnostic filenames describe four logical processors, not four independent physical cores. Hosted topology and Linux parity remain unproven.

next: Investigate scheduling and resource placement without changing production behavior or the gate; no animation fix is supported by this control.
